description: This PHP file outputs a block of JavaScript code that includes multiple external JavaScript library references and defines several JavaScript functions related to rendering and interacting with RGraph charts within a SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: rgraphMouseMove
methods.description: Changes cursor to pointer on mouse move over a graph shape.

methods.name: calculateMaxYForSmallNumbers
methods.description: Calculates maximum Y value for small number datasets, ensuring a minimum of 5.

methods.name: resizeGraph
methods.description: Resizes a graph element based on its parent container and adjusts text size accordingly.

methods.name: resizeGraphs
methods.description: Resizes all graphs with class 'resizableCanvas' on window resize.

methods.name: myPipelineBySalesStageClick
methods.description: Handles click events on pipeline charts, opening a URL with filters based on sales stage.

methods.name: outcomeByMonthClick
methods.description: Handles click events on outcome-by-month charts, opening a URL with specific date and stage filters.

methods.name: allOpportunititesByLeadSourceByOutcomeClick
methods.description: Handles click events on lead source/outcome charts, filtering opportunities accordingly.

methods.name: opportunitiesByLeadSourceDashletClick
methods.description: Handles click events on opportunities lead source dashlets, filtering by lead source.

methods.name: myFunnelClick
methods.description: Handles click events on funnel charts, filtering opportunities by sales stage and date range.
